Terms of use

Effective 22 October 2026

Fievel is a free, open-source plugin. The MIT License governs use, copying, modification and distribution of the Fievel software. The full license is available in the Fievel repository.

Fievel is in beta. Its features may change, and paid features or services may be introduced in the future. Any paid offering will be announced on this site before it applies, and it will not change the license of Fievel versions already released.

No additional usage terms apply to the Fievel plugin. Fievel currently has no accounts, paid features or transactions. It runs on your computer; any coding-agent service or dependency you choose to use with it is subject to that provider's own terms.

The optional hosted Fievel server is provided free of charge and as is, without warranty or availability guarantee, and may change or stop. Send it only content you are authorized to share. Its handling of your content is described in the privacy policy.

For questions or support, open an issue in the Fievel repository.
